noise.measurement_scope: Stationary small-signal; VINP-referred, VINN AC-grounded; not switched ADC noise

rejection.required: Matched-OP differential measurement and explicit PSRR-minus reference/stimulus definition
rejection.psrr_minus_scope: VINP/VINN sources and load follow VSS; VDD held at absolute AC ground; exported VOUT is absolute-ground referenced
rejection.historical_psrr_minus_scope: Inputs and VDD held at absolute AC ground; not the same stimulus

swing.scope: Forward unity-follower DC transfer with moving input common mode
swing.missing: Original fixed-common-mode inverting test (equal 10-Mohm feedback/input resistors), reverse sweep and per-point M6/M7 operating points
swing.caveat: Low-input GminDC notices and 207 suppressed notices; output extrema are not qualified output swing
